name: calcom_list_bookings
description: List bookings. Optional filters: `status` (upcoming, past, cancelled, unconfirmed), `attendeeEmail`, and `afterStart`/`beforeEnd` (UTC ISO-8601). Returns each booking with its `uid`, title, times, status, and attendees.

status.description: Filter by status: upcoming, past, cancelled, or unconfirmed (optional).

attendeeEmail.description: Filter to bookings for this attendee email (optional).

afterStart.description: Only bookings starting after this UTC ISO-8601 time (optional).

beforeEnd.description: Only bookings ending before this UTC ISO-8601 time (optional).
